clusters.title: Improve block error handling and add agent capabilities
clusters.summary: Users want improved error handling in various AI blocks to gracefully manage edge cases like non-JSON responses, empty responses, and missing arguments. Additionally, they want new capabilities including optional external memory providers for durable agent memory, a pre-execution verification layer with audit logging, and a new onboarding experience to make the framework more robust and easier to adopt.
clusters.representative_need: Add pre-execution verification layer for LLM outputs with audit logging
